# Billy McComiskey — Original Compositions Archive

> A static, client-side digital archive of the original musical compositions of
> Billy McComiskey, NEA National Heritage Fellow and master Irish traditional
> accordionist. Each composition carries sheet music (ABC notation), playable
> audio, credits, and the historical story behind it.

This file describes the site's data models for machine consumers (LLMs, crawlers,
and archival ingest tools such as the Irish Traditional Music Archive, ITMA).

## Data source

- Canonical dataset: `/data/tunes.json` — a JSON array of `Tune` objects.
- All data is static and served client-side; there is no backend API.

## Data model: `Tune`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `id` | string | URL-safe stable identifier (kebab-case). |
| `title` | string | Display title, e.g. "The Diamond". |
| `rhythm` | string | Tune type: `reel`, `jig`, `slip jig`, `hornpipe`, `polka`, `slide`, `waltz`, `air`, `march`, `barndance`. |
| `key` | string | Musical key, e.g. `G`, `Dmaj`, `Amaj`. |
| `narrative` | string | The historical story behind the composition. |
| `credits` | object | See `Credits` below. |
| `archivalMetadata` | object | See `ArchivalMetadata` below. |
| `abcNotation` | string | Standard ABC notation, rendered client-side via abcjs. |

### `Credits`

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `composer` | string | Composer of the melody (Billy McComiskey for originals). |
| `storyBy` | string? | Author of the narrative, when different from the composer. |
| `editor` | string? | Person who edited/transcribed the entry. |

### `ArchivalMetadata`

Shaped to match ITMA ingest standards.

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `sourceCollection` | string | Name of the collection this entry belongs to. |
| `rightsHolder` | string | Entity/person holding the rights. |
| `recordingDate` | string | ISO-8601 date or year of the reference recording (`n.d.` if unknown). |

## Local developer tools (MCP)

A local Model Context Protocol server (`tools/mcp-server.mjs`, run via `npm run mcp`)
exposes read tools over this dataset for coding agents:

- `get_all_tunes` — returns the full `Tune[]` dataset.
- `get_tune` — returns a single `Tune` by `id`.
- `render_interactive_tune` — returns the ABC notation and metadata for a tune
  so an agent can verify notation/rendering changes.
